Hi team,

Quick context: Cygnus Health (prospect) is moving to a multi-region deployment and is asking for us to align pricing across their US/EMEA usage for the first 12 months. Procurement escalated because their internal procurement team needs a single committed rate for forecasting and a temporary waiver for the onboarding surcharge.

What I'm requesting: an internal exception (VP/CFO signoff) to offer the following for a 12‑month committed term:
- 20% discount off list committed rate (applies to token + inference unit price)
- Waive the one-time onboarding surcharge for the first 3 months
- Maintain existing SLAs; no product-level concessions beyond packaging

Attached: proposed_rate_matrix (PDF) and an internal exception memo with revenue impact and risk notes.

Why reasonable: Cygnus is pursuing a 3-region proof (US/UK/CA) with an expected ARR run‑rate of ~$1.1M after month 6. They committed verbally to a 12‑month minimum and want to sign quickly if we can give a single rate across regions. Loss risk: medium if we keep list pricing (they will likely go to a competitor).

Ask: Can I get VP/CFO review and signoff by EOD Monday (4/13)? If approved, I will update HubSpot and send a conditional term sheet to Procurement.

Attachments: cygnus_proposed_rate_matrix_20260410.pdf, redwood_internal_exception_memo_20260410.docx

Thanks,
Nikhil
